prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after seeing a truck for sale that looks just like your old one.
response:
*[Voicemail beep]*

"Hey, buddy, it's your dad. Listen—you're never gonna believe this. I'm driving back from the hardware store just now, and I go past the Hendersons' place, you know, out on Route 9? And there's a truck sitting out front with a FOR SALE sign in the window.

Now hang on, hang on. It's the EXACT same one we used to have. The old Ford. Same green, same everything. I mean it's got the little chrome bumper and everything. I almost drove off the road, I swear.

Took me right back. You remember we used to load up the whole back of that thing and head out to the lake? You couldn't have been more than, what, eight? Nine? You'd sit up front and mess with the radio the whole dang time. Drove your mother crazy.

Anyway. I wrote down the number. I'm not saying I'm gonna buy it. Your mother would kill me. But I'm... I don't know. Just thought you'd get a kick out of it. Funny how a thing like that hits you.

Give me a call when you get a chance. No rush.
